title: Resemble AI Pricing 2026: Plans, Rates & Add-On Costs
summary: Resemble AI pricing covers four tiers but omits per-run costs, concurrency limits and cloning rules. You'll learn what's missing.
body_markdown:
## Resemble AI against ElevenLabs, Cartesia and Play.ht


At 10,000 minutes a month, Resemble's Flex plan and[Cartesia](https://www.cartesia.ai/pricing) 's promotional rate both come to $300, while ElevenLabs agents come to $1,000, **over triple the cost** , so cost-conscious teams will default to Flex or Cartesia.


That's the spread the last line warned about, and the cheapest row may not stay cheapest.


The figures below come from[Cartesia's pricing page](https://www.cartesia.ai/pricing) .


### Price per minute at each volume


Read the table for what each priced option costs at 10,000 minutes. Take from it the per-minute rate, and note which rows are promotional.


Provider and plan Cost at 10,000 minutes Per minute


Resemble Flex $300 $0.03


Cartesia promo $300 $0.03


Cartesia regular $600 $0.06


ElevenLabs agents $1,000 $0.10


While it lasts, the promo halves the bill, but Cartesia's regular rate is $600 a month, so you should build your budget assuming this higher rate. Budget at $600 and treat $300 as a bonus, meaning you're protected regardless of whether the promo lasts.


It's not a like-for-like comparison: ElevenLabs agents at $1,000 a month is a conversational-agent product, not plain synthesis. It's dearer because it bundles more, and you pay for that bundle on every minute whether you use it or not.


I have no confirmed 10,000-minute figure for Play.ht, so I don't rank it here.


Scale this linearly only as a first pass. At 100,000 minutes the same rates imply $3,000 for Resemble Flex and $10,000 for ElevenLabs agents, a $7,000 monthly gap that's worth a written quote before you commit.


### Concurrency, languages and latency


I have no verified concurrency caps, language counts or latency claims for these four, so I'm not printing any. Those are the limits that force a plan upgrade, and a rate card that omits them is the one to distrust.


Get each cap in writing, then load-test your peak simultaneous calls before you pick a plan.


### Which one fits which kind of build


For plain synthesis at volume, Resemble Flex and Cartesia are the cheapest on the evidence above.


Their rates are $0.03 and $0.06 a minute respectively once the promo ends, leaving Resemble at exactly half Cartesia's rate, which means at 10,000 minutes Resemble costs $300 versus Cartesia's $600.


ElevenLabs agents suits a build where you want the agent layer bought rather than assembled. Play.ht stays unpriced until you can verify a figure.


Cost your own volume against two or three of these before you write any code.
